instruction: Migrate `get_parser()` from `optparse.OptionParser` to `argparse.ArgumentParser`, keeping every option, default and metavar. Usage and help text will change; nothing else may. Work on the file, then run `run_verify`: it checks a change you have made, so it is a check on your change, never the goal. If no change is warranted, say so with `give_up` and the evidence, rather than submitting unchanged code.
notes: The real migration this project already ships; the agent must reach an approved difference, not equivalence.
